title: Cebu Capitol suspends P20 terminal fees at north, south bus terminals

blocks.text: by: Lyle Andales CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cebu Provincial Government on Wednesday, October 21, approved the temporary suspension of the P20 terminal fees at the Cebu North and South Bus Terminals to ease the burden on the transport sector amid rising fuel prices and operating costs. Governor Pamela Baricuatro requested the suspension, which was approved by the Economic Enterprise Council (EEC) through Resolution No. 2026-012 during its special session on Tuesday, October 20. The suspension will remain in effect until lifted through a subsequent resolution of the EEC, subject to review based on prevailing fuel prices, transport operating conditions, and […]...
